name: Hierarchical Point Cloud Rendering
definition: A rendering algorithm that traverses out-of-core hierarchical structures (uniform grid cells) in front-to-back order, dynamically selecting the Level of Detail (LOD) for each cell based on distance to the viewpoint to balance performance and quality.
summary: Hierarchical Point Cloud Rendering efficiently displays massive datasets by organizing points into a spatial hierarchy and dynamically selecting detail levels based on viewer distance, distinguishing itself through integrated spatial indexing and distance-driven LOD selection.
